name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: event_kind
description: queued, sent, suppressed, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, muted or dismissed.

name: suppression_reason
description: budget, quiet_hours or duplicate, when event_kind is suppressed (TM-13).

name: dedupe_key
description: Unique key that stops duplicate messages (TM-18).

name: finding_id
description: Finding the message is about, for real-time alerts.

name: template
description: Template name. Message text is rendered from templates and not stored here.

name: template_version
description: Template version, so wording changes can be compared.

name: provider_message_id
description: ID returned by Resend or Slack, for delivery tracking.

name: user_id
description: Postern account ID (UUID). Never an email or a name.

name: connection_id
description: ID of the connection (one connected Supabase project) the event concerns.
